cases.purpose: 验证模型下载中断后可通过 .part 和 Range 续传
cases.expected_signal: Range header is emitted when partial file exists

cases.purpose: 验证已完整下载的模型文件不会重复下载
cases.expected_signal: file status becomes cached

cases.purpose: 验证 Streamlit 页面虽然 HTTP 200 但包含错误标记时不能通过
cases.expected_signal: streamlit_dom_probe status is fail

cases.purpose: 验证 HTTP 200 但没有当前 trace 时不能判定成功
cases.expected_signal: verify status remains uncertain

cases.purpose: 验证 Gradio /config discovery 能构造正确 POST trace 请求
cases.expected_signal: request is sent to /api/predict with fn_index

cases.purpose: 验证权限不足时 repair action 会被 policy 拒绝
cases.expected_signal: policy allowed is false

cases.purpose: 验证模型文件 checksum 不一致时不会进入缓存成功态
cases.expected_signal: download status becomes failed with sha256 mismatch

cases.purpose: 验证浏览器 DOM 中出现当前 trace 时可以作为强证据
cases.expected_signal: browser_dom_probe status is pass

cases.purpose: 验证模型下载器可以并发下载多个必要文件且保持 manifest 顺序
cases.expected_signal: two files are downloaded with max_workers > 1

cases.purpose: 验证远端 etag 变化时本地缓存不会被误当成有效
cases.expected_signal: cached file is redownloaded when etag metadata mismatches

cases.purpose: 验证模型缓存清理可以先 dry-run 生成候选，再受控删除
cases.expected_signal: old cache entry is selected and deleted only when dry_run is false

cases.purpose: 验证模型缓存清理可以按来源过滤，并通过 keep-list 保护关键模型
cases.expected_signal: only matching non-kept cache entry is selected and deleted

cases.purpose: 验证 repair loop 会限制同一问题的自动修复尝试次数，并对不安全 rerun_from 做回退
cases.expected_signal: second repair gate is rejected and rerun_from falls back to safe stage

cases.purpose: 验证需要人工批准的 repair action 只有在 operator approval 存在时才能通过
cases.expected_signal: policy is rejected before approval and allowed after approval

cases.purpose: 验证服务进程启动后很快退出时 runner 不能判定启动成功
cases.expected_signal: runner status is failed and summary is service process exited

cases.purpose: 验证历史输出文件不能作为本次 verify 的新鲜证据
cases.expected_signal: artifact_freshness remains uncertain

cases.purpose: 验证 Gradio /config 中 api_name 带斜杠且前置 dependency 不可用时仍能选中正确 API
cases.expected_signal: request is sent to /api/predict with selected fn_index

cases.purpose: 验证 token 缺失或 401 日志会被诊断为 auth_required
cases.expected_signal: log classifier category is auth_required

cases.purpose: 验证 resume 会按 repair 的 rerun_from_effective 从安全阶段重跑
cases.expected_signal: only verify and report are rerun when rerun_from_effective is verify

cases.purpose: 验证 resume 阶段跳转会生成执行审计摘要并写入 report
cases.expected_signal: report lists reused stages and rerun stages

cases.purpose: 验证 token 缺失时 report 只展示所需变量名，不记录密钥值
cases.expected_signal: report includes HF_TOKEN name and excludes token values
